Platform & Organization Profile

About VORA AI (서비스 소개)

VORA AI (koreatravel.cc) is an intelligent Korean tourism concierge platform built to empower international travelers with authentic, high-fidelity cultural itineraries, real-time weather clothing guides, and barrier-free navigation across all 226 administrative districts of South Korea.

Our Core Mission

Traveling in a foreign country can often feel daunting due to language barriers, dispersed transit systems, and fragmented information. Our mission is to eliminate these friction points by combining verified government public tourism data with Google DeepMind Gemini AI, enabling anyone to experience the true beauty of Korea — from iconic UNESCO World Heritage sites in Gyeongju to hidden seaside cafes in Gangneung.

Key Architectural Pillars

🏛️ 100% Official Public Data

Directly synchronized with the Korea Tourism Organization (TourAPI 4.0), providing live data on over 4,100+ registered national landmarks, cultural assets, and verified photo spots.

🧠 Google Gemini AI Engine

Analyzes spatial clustering, daily time budgets, and visitor movement patterns to construct optimized, zero-fatigue 1-day to 5-day itineraries.

🌤️ Real-Time Weather & Outfit

Synthesizes live Korea Meteorological Administration (KMA) sensor readings with Pinterest-style aesthetic lookbooks to suggest the exact clothing needed for today's weather.

🌐 Quad-Lingual Accessibility

Complete multilingual support across English, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, and Korean to welcome global tourists seamlessly.

Publisher & Technology Standards

VORA AI operates in strict compliance with international web publishing standards, accessibility guidelines, and intellectual property rights. All commercial store names, chain restaurants, and unauthorized scrapers are filtered out at the database architecture level to preserve a pure, authentic cultural tourism experience.
